_doc: PROPOSED additions to data-clean/bp_water_allowlist.json for the MX/EG coastal expansion. These are named navigable inland/lagoon water bodies invisible to the ocean-mask; bboxes are coarse and must be validated/snapped by Grok during the seal. Open-ocean crossings (Cancun, Cozumel, Holbox channel proper, Cabo, La Paz, Alexandria harbours, Marsa Alam, Dahab) do NOT need allowlisting.

water_bodies.name: Nile River (Cairo — Maadi/Downtown/Giza)
water_bodies.reason: Navigable river; Nile Taxi scheduled water-service piers (Maadi/Zaghloul, Zamalek/Downtown, Giza). Riverine geometry-only lane — no economics.

water_bodies.name: Laguna de Manialtepec (Puerto Escondido)
water_bodies.reason: Navigable coastal lagoon ~18 km west of Puerto Escondido; bioluminescence/birdlife boat network.

water_bodies.name: El Gouna lagoons (Abu Tig / Downtown marinas)
water_bodies.reason: Purpose-built lagoon town north of Hurghada with a live water-taxi mesh between marinas and island hotels.

water_bodies.name: Laguna Yalahau / Holbox channel (Chiquilá–Holbox)
water_bodies.reason: Shallow lagoon/channel crossing to car-free Isla Holbox; may read as inland to the ocean-mask.
